thread:
Lina: quick heads-up — ZenithHealth renewal thread. they signed intent for 120 seats but now asking to shift to 6mo term + 200 seats for a lower rate. onboarding is still blocked by SSO invite not accepted.
Tom: ugh, when did they ask for the term change?
Lina: yesterday in email from their procurement. mention: pricing team flagged a concession request.
Priya: how far along is the PO? any vendor code issues?
Marco: procurement said they'll issue a PO once legal confirms amendment wording + VAT entity. they asked for net30 on invoice.
Jesse (Legal): can you drop the amendment draft? I'll do a quick redline.
Lina: sharing proposed amendment snippet — please skim:```
- Term: 6 months (start date 2025-05-01)
- Seats: 200 seats, tiered pricing at $0.009/token equivalent (annualized discount not applied)
- Payment: Net30, invoice to ZenithHealth UK Ltd (VAT ID: GB123456789)
- Onboarding kickoff contingent on signed amendment + PO
```
Tom: two quick flags: 1) shorter term increases churn risk, 2) pricing math needs finance sign-off.
Finance Bot: flagging for review — projected ARR delta vs standard 12mo: -28%. need revenue ops approval.
Priya: can we do a one-time onboarding credit instead of further discount? keeps list price intact.
Lina: customer asked specifically for price reduction across seats, but open to credit for migration hours.
Jesse (Legal): amendment ok with redline for recipient entity; will add clause: "signature by authorized signer required; electronic signatures accepted."
Marco: procurement also requested Docusign envelope to include both UK entity and US parent for billing trace.
docusign-bot: Docusign envelope template check: recommended fields missing: `billing_entity`, `vat_id`, `po_number` — please populate.
Kai (Eng Enablement): onboarding resource note — we can start enablement workshops once PO is in hand; pre-kickoff: we need SSO invite accepted and one admin account created.
Lina: SSO invite was sent by platform-team last week — customer says their IT hasn't accepted; can we resend with a direct link?
Tom: platform-team, can you resend and cc their security contact? short term we can do a temporary org admin with limited access.
Priya: if finance approves a limited concession (one-time credit of $15k) + standard per-seat list price, would that be acceptable to them?
Lina: they told me $18k credit would do it. asking if we can split credit across invoices.
Marco: splitting okay if Finance approves and Legal adds payment schedule to amendment.
Finance Bot: provisional approval for $15k credit split across two invoices pending ARR impact signoff from revenue ops.
Jesse (Legal): i'll add payment schedule + signature lines for both entities; need to confirm signer's name.
Lina: i'll ask procurement for signer and PO ETA — pinging them now.
Lina: @all — action items: 1) Jesse: finalize amendment w/ signature & payment schedule; 2) Finance: final credit sign-off; 3) Platform: resend SSO invite + temp admin; 4) Kai: prep enablement deck for kickoff. i'll update when PO arrives. :thumbsup:
Tom: thanks — logging this as renewal risk (medium) in CRM. will follow up with account exec if we need exec escalation.
Lina: update: procurement replied — PO promised by COB Tue, signer = "Helen Park, Head of Procurement". they agreed to two invoices.
Marco: great — once PO is in, i'll attach vendorcode and send to billing.
Priya: if PO slips beyond Tue we should offer a one-week extension on pricing to avoid churn.
Lina: noted. i'll loop exec if we hit slip.
Tom: good plan. keep the thread tight.
